description: Compile registered brand tokens with the shipped compiler. Use it when you need fresh CSS and JSON; use brand_create to create a brand or brand_apply to change its source. Returns inline CSS variables, CSS and JSON plus artifact paths, hashes and sizes. apply:true builds in isolated artifact storage; omission previews the artifacts without writing. Requested brand/theme selects the inline scope; full CSS includes every registered scope. Source and shipped runtime files stay unchanged. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#tokens_build; full schema: oods://schemas/tokens_build.input.json.

brand.description: Selects values compiled from current source, returned inline as CSS variables, CSS and JSON and written on apply. Full CSS includes all registered scopes; TypeScript and Tailwind artifacts retain A/light defaults.
